session.text: Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.
session.author: Thomas Edison

session.text: La paix vient de l'intérieur. Ne la cherche pas à l'extérieur.
session.author: Proverbe

session.text: La porte du changement ne peut s'ouvrir que de l'intérieur
session.author: Inconnu

session.text: One day your life will flash before your eyes. Make sure it is worth watching.
session.author: Mooie

session.text: If we don't allow ourselves to make mistakes, we will never invest in things that are radical.
session.author: Jeff Clavier
